gen-fs-chubbo-gf-noticia-text: Chubbo moves around every bend as smoothly as a marker tip, casual and inviting. Noticia Text is the literary one, a serif whose lowercase fills most of the letter height and whose curves have wide entrances.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-piazzolla: Marker-drawn curves with a wire-like single-line skeleton give Chubbo its casual, inviting face. Piazzolla settles beside it with refined authority, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its e opened wide.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-pridi: Casual and inviting, Chubbo glides around every curve like a marker tip, while Pridi stands tall beside it. Its near-capital lowercase and generous curve gaps keep paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-scope-one: Plain marker strokes, friendly and loose: that is Chubbo, with every character drawn the same way. Scope One is the sturdier partner, a serif with stubby ascenders, counters that spill outward, and a big x-height.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-slabo-13px: Inviting, casual, marker-drawn: that is Chubbo. Slabo 13px follows with bookish dignity, its tall a, s and e opening wide enough that the rounded marker heading never feels crowded out.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-suwannaphum: A line that never changes width gives Chubbo its casual, marker-drawn welcome. Suwannaphum is the dignified one, a serif whose c opens like a bent paperclip and whose high x-height stands squared-off.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Glyphs sit like tiles with wide grout lines in Audiowide, all one line thickness and unmistakably futuristic. Noto Sans Meroitic brings the approachable side: see-through c openings, full-height lowercase.
gen-eater-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans reads modern and crisp, its lowercase rising near cap height. Above it, Eater brings a dark, aggressive heading with wide gaps and thin strokes, and that gap in temperament is the pair's best trait.
gen-flavors-gf-stack-sans-text: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors stacks heavy diagonals and a towering x-height over the marker-like line of Stack Sans Text. The body's big-bodied lowercase gives the showy heading somewhere to rest.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-sc: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, with a pronounced x-height and letters that never seem to pinch shut. It earns its keep big and short; Noto Sans SC takes the rest.
